Name: Smaller Fish Ponds
Author: PeaslyWellbott
Description:
Allows construction of a new farm building, the "Fish Well", which is a 3x3 version of the Fish Pond.

This is not a replacer; both structures can be constructed, and existing Fish Ponds will be unchanged.

Fish Wells cost the same as Fish Ponds, but in exchange for the space efficiency, they work slower (configurable):
[code]﻿"FishWellsWorkSlower" (default true) - whether Fish Wells spawn and produce slower with variables below
"SlowSpawnSpeed" (default 0.65) - chance that any given day will count towards spawning a new fish
"SlowProduceSpeed" (default 0.65) - chance that any given day will attempt to create fish produce
[/code]
Further available options :
[code]﻿"InstantConstruction" (default false) - remove construction time (ignore the minor graphical glitch during construction)
"WellPopulationCap" (default 10) - set a lower final population limit for Wells
[/code]
Available Reskins:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7692]Medieval (plus Seasonal)[/url]﻿
[/list]
Compatible with:
[list]
[*]Mods which change Fish Pond construction costs (these will be mirrored onto the Fish Wells)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4703]Pond Painter[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4702]Anything Ponds[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6516]Happy Fish Jump[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿ (but slower production and spawning is not reflected in the infobox)
[*]With a little luck, most things which would interact with Ponds
[/list]
Uninstallation:
[list]
[*]Fish Wells are saved as small Fish Ponds, so the mod can be removed freely without damage to your farm or assets. They should still be destroyed soon as they will look quite strange.
[/list]
